title: Black Friday Deal: Apple TV Streaming Service for $6.99/Month
content:
A new Black Friday deal for Apple TV will be rolling out today. Until November 30 at 8 p.m. Pacific Time, new and qualified returning customers in the U.S. can subscribe to the Apple TV streaming service for $6.99 per month for up to six months, which is more than 50% off the regular price of $14.99 per month. No ads.
